headline: Every connection,
intro: Check your network from different regions and providers.
pingDesc: Measure latency and packet loss across networks.
tcpingDesc: Check port connectivity and connection latency.
httpDesc: Inspect website status and response timing.
dnsDesc: Compare DNS answers from different regions.
tracerouteDesc: Follow each hop along the network path.
mtrDesc: Sample routes to inspect per-hop latency and loss.
targetHint: Enter a domain or public IP
notReadyDesc: The site owner needs to connect a DNSPup API account to run real tests.
waitingDesc: Enter a target and choose nodes. Real results will appear here.
waitingRunDesc: Results arrive together when the test completes. MTR can take several minutes.
privateDesc: Visitors run tests without receiving an API key.
realDesc: Tests run on authorized DNSPup nodes.
regionDesc: Choose test locations by region and provider.
helpIntro: Choose a tool, enter an address, select nodes and run a test.
helpContent: Ping measures delay and loss; TCPing checks ports; HTTP inspects website responses; DNS compares answers; Traceroute and MTR show network paths. The node service validates IPv4/IPv6 support when executing a test.
helpCost: Each submission may consume the site owner's API quota. Avoid duplicate submissions while waiting. A disconnected browser does not mean the upstream test stopped.
privacyContent: Targets and required parameters are sent through this server to DNSPup. Essential request records are retained for 7 days for diagnostics and quota protection. URL query strings are excluded from these logs. Do not include passwords or sensitive information in target addresses.
privacyExternal: Custom external logos and ad images may send requests to their image hosts. No ad resources load when ads are disabled. Recent targets stay in this browser and can be cleared. URL query parameters are omitted.
errorGeneric: Request failed. Try later or contact the site owner.
toolDisabled: This tool is not authorized for this API account
localLimit: The request exceeds a quota or rate limit. Please try later.
serviceError: Node service is unavailable. Contact the site owner.
tagline: A clearer view of your network.
homeIntro: Choose a tool to check your website or network.
repeatCost: Each round samples every node once and uses one API request. Rounds respect site limits. Stopping waits for the current result; errors end the run.
ipStatsHint: Select an IP to filter results
apiPending: Not yet supported by the customer API
tcpingBreadcrumb: Multi-region TCP port and latency test
httpBreadcrumb: Website speed and HTTP response test
mtrBreadcrumb: MTR route, hop latency and packet loss
recoverHint: Queries the original request only; no new probe. Platforms supporting job queries retain results for 24 hours. Older platforms use a 10-minute local memory cache that is lost on restart.
diagnosticCounts: Returned {returned}/{expected} · OK {ok} · Partial {partial} · Timeout {timeout} · Unavailable {unavailable} · Failed {failed} · Missing {missing}
destinationCounts: Destination replied {reached} · No destination reply {unreached} · Unknown destination {unknownDestination}
taskCompletionHint: Task completion does not mean every node succeeded. Evaluate HTTP status codes separately.
traceCompletionHint: Task completion, route completeness and destination replies are separate. ICMP loss does not measure application traffic loss.
